title: Historical Chronology and Archival Anteriority
goal: Layer earlier historical states and completed passive events before a past turning point using the pluperfect.
grammar: Pluperfect indicative in active, ser-passive and se-passive historical frames

items: I can layer earlier historical conditions before a past turning point using the pluperfect indicative.
I can use passive pluperfect forms (*había sido* + participle and *se había* + participle) in archival reports.
I can place adverbs and object pronouns accurately around *había* + participle in formal prose.
